runtime.scope: family-owned candidate-local Python under the ignored dedicated Portable

source_and_time.read_policy: verify exact bytes, SHA-256, row count, schema, raw monotonicity, OHLC/spread/volume integrity and normalize every row while retaining only exact event-window rows in memory
source_and_time.normalization: raw epoch-like integer rendered as timezone-naive broker wall clock, localized Europe/Helsinki with ambiguous/nonexistent failure, converted to true UTC and Europe/London
source_and_time.complete_event: all four frozen symbols have every exact London minute 15:34 through 16:35 inclusive; no fill or later-row completion

features_and_signal.ATR20: twenty causal completed M1 true ranges ending on each frozen decision bar, including the immediately prior observed close
features_and_signal.pre: 15:54 Bid close minus 15:45 Bid open; follow strict sign; enter 15:55
features_and_signal.post: 16:04 Bid close minus 15:55 Bid open; fade strict sign; enter 16:05

portfolio_risk.same_timestamp_snapshot: one actual closed-balance snapshot after all prior-date settlement
portfolio_risk.volume: floor target-risk lots to step and maximum; use minimum only inside the hard cap

execution_and_economics.long: entry Ask; fixed stop evaluated on Bid low; time exit Bid open
execution_and_economics.short: entry Bid; fixed stop evaluated on Ask high; time exit Ask open
execution_and_economics.pre_lifecycle: ten held M1 bars 15:55..16:04 then 16:05 open
execution_and_economics.post_lifecycle: twenty-five held M1 bars 16:05..16:29 then 16:30 open
execution_and_economics.actual: direction-specific price PnL plus signed swap; declared geometry aborts on any rollover boundary
execution_and_economics.stress: actual minus the lifecycle's observed direction-specific spread burden once more
execution_and_economics.closed_balance_drawdown: update after each same-exit-time trade in frozen symbol order

improvement_audit.population: every complete nonzero signal in both variants whether accepted or blocked
improvement_audit.values: one-lot raw/actual/stressed close R, raw Bid MFE/MAE R, sibling-direction relationship, year/pair/direction/ordinary/month-end/quarter-end, costs, blocks, hard-stop and declared-lifecycle truncation
improvement_audit.broad_headroom: one 5/10/20/25/30 horizon positive raw and stressed in both years, at least three pairs, both directions and ordinary/month-end slices, at least eight each
improvement_audit.successor_authority: retain at most one bounded seed; never execute it inside V1

confirmation.condition: byte-equal durable/raw one-selected-passer result and fresh combined source
confirmation.development_replay: the selected development metrics and gates must reproduce exactly from the combined source before locked economics
confirmation.native_tape: written only after every locked and whole proxy gate passes

outputs.precheck: stdout only; persistent file count zero
outputs.write_policy: stage one complete no-overwrite bundle and move result last

next_authorized_action: after this exact implementation freeze reaches origin/main, run exactly one complete two-variant development bundle and mandatory improvement-potential audit
